title: Qualification event log, v0
description: The structured, redacted transcript of one receipt (<receiptId>.events.json), committed next to it. Events come from the runner, the autorun Lua driver, the plugin under test (through the values its Lua functions return) and the operator. User and machine names, local paths outside the placeholders <workRoot>, <sandbox>, <bundle:NAME> and <repo>, process ids and addresses outside the scenario, and raw debug output are removed before the file is written; long lists are summarized. The receipt's eventLog.sha256 is the SHA-256 of this file's UTF-8 bytes after CRLF is normalized to LF. Validated by tests/CheatEngine.SDK.Repository.Tests/Qualification.

summarized.description: Present when the runner shortened the log: how many events were kept and how many were dropped from the middle.
